items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: And this young trumpet player there, George, I can't think of his last name. But he was a wonderful trumpet man.

ctx.x: Because we was playing back in the dance hall. You see, the bar was up in the front. And the dance hall was in the back. Big dance hall. So there was a lot of tourists that used to come back there, you know, and listen to us. Pete Fountain used to come there before he started. And Frank Asunder and his brother, Freddie, they used to come and sit in with us. And this young trumpet player there, George, I can't think of his last name. But he was a wonderful trumpet man. He used to play with the bass of Street Six.…
Yes, I know he was a trumpet player.
